fingerprintAlgorithm: SHA256(JSON.stringify(sorted unique [{path,sha256}])); individual SHA256 of raw working-tree bytes
exclusions: dotenv files, including public examples; runtime policies are fingerprinted in source
gitNormalization: Gate fingerprint uses exact working-tree bytes. Candidate Git content is compared separately with exact raw bytes or Git clean filters; commit SHA is not the raw-byte fingerprint.
